header: Access the Microsoft Defender XDR APIs
content:
Article • 04/15/2025 • Applies to: Microsoft Defender XDR
Microsoft Defender XDR exposes much of its data and actions through a set of programmatic
APIs. These APIs help you automate workflows and make full use of Microsoft Defender XDR's
capabilities.
In general, you'll need to take the following steps to use the APIs:
Create a Microsoft Entra application
Get an access token using this application
Use the token to access the Microsoft Defender XDR API
Once you've accomplished these steps, you're ready to access the Microsoft Defender XDR API
using a particular context.
Use this context for apps that run without a signed-in user present, such as background
services or daemons.
1. Create a Microsoft Entra web application.
2. Assign the desired permissions to the application.
3. Create a key for the application.
７ Note
Try our new APIs using MS Graph security API. Find out more at: Use the Microsoft
Graph security API - Microsoft Graph | Microsoft Learn.
